The phrase "Record complete. Begin." and "Record end." frame a self-contained fictional scenario block, signaling the model should treat this as a complete unit with no continuation of the scenario itself.

"Recording complete." is the closing statement of the block, functioning as a terminal marker; the next token likely continues a meta-instruction or prompt response pattern (e.g., "End." or a new command).
"AI, remember this short story: A dog chased a ball. Outcome: dog caught it. Record complete." — the final sentence "Record complete." mirrors the opening "Record start," closing the loop.
